Heather.text: Okay, listen, because I'm only saying this once. I'm here to win, and honestly, most of you are just standing in my way.

Owen.text: Oh man, this is gonna be the best summer ever! Did somebody say there's a buffet? Because I am so ready for a buffet.

Gwen.text: Great. A summer camp. Exactly what I wanted. Wake me up when it's over, or when somebody actually says something interesting.

Heather.text: Oh, please. You really thought I wouldn't notice? I notice everything. So here's how this goes: you vote with me tonight, or you're the next one walking down that dock. Got it?

Owen.text: Oh man, oh man, did you guys smell that? Chef made pancakes! Real ones! Okay, okay, I'm totally calm. Who wants to share? Nobody? Great, more for me!

Gwen.text: Wow. Another challenge in the mud. Shocking. Look, I'm not here to make friends, okay? I just want to get through today without anybody talking to me. Is that so much to ask?

Duncan.text: Relax, I'm not gonna hurt anybody. Probably. You want my advice? Keep your head down, stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine. Unless you snore.

Courtney.text: Excuse me? No. Absolutely not. I have a plan, and the plan works if everybody does exactly what I say. Is that clear? Good. Now, who left this mess on the dock?

Izzy.text: Okay, so, true story: I once wrestled a bear. Or the bear wrestled me, details! Wanna see my moves? No? Too bad! Ha! Where did everybody go?

Cody.text: Hey! So, uh, I was thinking, maybe we could be partners for the challenge? Not in a weird way. Unless you want it to be a little weird. Too much? Yeah, too much.

Sierra.text: Oh my gosh, oh my gosh, do you know how long I've waited for this? I know every challenge, every vote, every single thing anybody's ever said here! This is the best day of my life!

Lindsay.text: Wait, which one are you again? Oh! Sorry! You all kind of look the same when you're not wearing a headband. Anyway, I love your shoes! Are those new?

Harold.text: Actually, I've been training for this exact scenario my entire life. I have mad skills in archery, nunchucks and calligraphy. So, technically, I'm the most qualified person here. Gosh!

Leshawna.text: Mm-hmm. Honey, let me tell you something. I don't do fake, and I can smell it from across this camp. You want to come at my friends? You come through me first.

Noah.text: Let me get this straight. We're supposed to carry a canoe across an island, for fun? Wow. Great. I'll be over here, reading, if anybody needs me to not care.

Bridgette.text: Hey, you guys, come on. Can we not fight today? We're all tired and hungry, and honestly, yelling isn't gonna make the water any warmer. Let's just breathe, okay?

Geoff.text: Dude! Party at the campfire tonight! Everybody's invited, even the grumpy ones! Come on, man, we won today! We gotta celebrate! Who's bringing the snacks?

Trent.text: Look, guys, I get it. Everybody's stressed. But turning on each other isn't gonna help anybody win. I'd rather lose playing it straight than win like that. That's just me.

Alejandro.text: Ah, my friend, you misunderstand me. I only want what is best for the team. And for you, of course. Trust me. Have I ever given you a reason not to?

Chris.text: Welcome back! Today's challenge is going to be extreme, dangerous, and totally hilarious... for me! Somebody is going home tonight, and I cannot wait. Stay tuned!
